measurement: cFS baseline with NO AI_LEARNER and NO model artifact
harness_note: These measurements are taken over ssh, so sshd/bash/systemd RSS is inside system_used_before. It is NOT subtracted: leaving it in enlarges the overhead and therefore shrinks the budget, which is the safe direction and is applied uniformly rather than chosen per result.
separability_rule: configs separate iff min(M2 VmHWM) > max(M3 VmHWM)
r_other_apps_note: NOT separable: min(M2)=5156 kB is not above max(M3)=5324 kB (M2 [5156, 6364, 5156], M3 [4112, 4112, 5324]). cFS loads every app as a .so into ONE process, so run-to-run variation of that single VmRSS is comparable to the mission apps' contribution. R_other_apps is therefore 0 NOT because it was measured as zero, but because R_OS_cFS is taken from M2, which already contains the mission apps -- adding it again would double-count.
r_os_cfs_derivation: max(guest system used before cFS, harness included) + max(M2 VmHWM)
scope: process/system RAM (NOT HAL device allocation -- see budgets.json scope_note)
